property_summary: For a recipient who has not yet claimed the bonus, calling getFirstWithdrawalBonus(address(this)) either reverts (if this contract rejects the 100 wei payout) or succeeds and empties the recipient's reward, since the test contract can always be trusted to have zero starting reward and to accept or reject predictably.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `getFirstWithdrawalBonus(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
